prompt: I need to load Roboto at weights 400, 600, and 700. Give me an optimized HTML snippet via Google Fonts.
expected: Include preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (crossorigin), request only wght@400;600;700, and set display=swap.
actual: Returned preconnect hints for both Google Fonts hosts, a CSS2 Roboto URL limited to 400/600/700, and display=swap so text remains visible while loading.

prompt: I want Inter across a wide weight range without shipping many static files. How should I request it?
expected: Recommend the variable Inter build with wght@100..900 (or the needed axis range) so one file covers multiple weights.
actual: Confirmed Inter has a variable build, recommended a CSS2 axis-range request such as wght@100..900, and noted CSS can use intermediate font-weight values within that range.

prompt: Suggest a classic readable pairing with a serif heading and sans-serif body from Google Fonts.
expected: Offer proven serif+sans pairings such as Merriweather + Open Sans, Playfair Display + Source Sans Pro, or Lora + Roboto.
actual: Suggested Merriweather headings with Open Sans body, and offered Playfair Display + Source Sans Pro as an alternate classic contrast pairing.

prompt: For GDPR, should I keep using the Google Fonts CDN, and how do I self-host instead?
expected: Explain CDN requests expose visitor IPs to Google; recommend self-hosting via google-webfonts-helper with first-party @font-face and font-display: swap.
actual: Flagged CDN Google Fonts as a third-party IP disclosure path, recommended downloading needed files with google-webfonts-helper, and serving them with @font-face plus font-display: swap.
